name: AirlineIrregularOpsRebookingDesk
tagline: Re-protect every disrupted passenger by priority – seats, care and compensation in one app.
description: A complete irregular-operations desk for Power Apps and Power Pages: disrupted flights, passenger priority (UMNR, medical SSR, tier, cabin, connections), seat-aware auto re-accommodation onto alternative flights, a rebooking board with transition rules, meal and hotel vouchers and indicative EU261-style compensation. Works in demo mode the moment it is dropped on a screen.
features: Auto re-accommodation by priority with plan preview
Seat map of free seats per alternative flight
Indicative compensation by distance band, extraordinary causes and re-routing
controlType: standard (2 controls: dataset + Power Pages field control)
